notes: Run 2026-11-12. Very limited usable sources. No official duty rota and no animal poison line found: Kenya Veterinary Board FAQ and Directorate of Veterinary Services pages list only contact details (DVS 020 8043441, KVB +254 722 305 253). Not opened (WebFetch provenance refused clinic URLs not returned by search): crystalvets.com (Crystal Vets, Westlands), ducknetvetclinic.co.ke (Ducknet, Lavington), thenoblevet.com (Noble Veterinary Surgeons, Brookside), petvillevet.co.ke (Petville, Nairobi), kspca.or.ke (KSPCA Nairobi/Mombasa/Nanyuki/Naivasha/Watamu; KSPCA Mombasa phone +254 759 346 935 only from a magazine article, shelter not clinic, site may move). Northern Kenya Veterinary Services (Nanyuki-Nyeri Road) named in a 2018 newspaper article without contact data. Nothing found for Diani, Naivasha, Nakuru, Eldoret, Malindi. Aggregators (businesslist, achisystems, bestcareservices, goafricaonline, jiji) deliberately not used as sources. Independent check 2026-11-12: Pets Society Vet Clinic removed - its page is in Arabic and says North Coast (Egypt), phone 01024343862 is an Egyptian number, not Kenya.
